label: Safety Depository
literalRoomDescription: This is a large rectangular room. The east and west walls were used for storing safety deposit boxes, but all have been carefully removed by evil persons. To the east, west, and south of the room are large doorways. The northern "wall" of the room is a shimmering curtain of light. In the center of the room is a large stone cube, about 10 feet on a side. Engraved on the side of the cube is some lettering.
safeSceneProfile: Rectangular bank room with removed deposit boxes, three broad doorways, separate northern light curtain and approximately ten-foot stone cube. Lettering belongs to observed cube, not an answer sign.

visibleInitialObjects.label: bank brochure
sourceText: On the ground is a small, worn piece of paper.

The paper is barely readable. You can only make out "... valuables are completely safe ... advanced magic technology ... impossible to take valuables from the depository ... either teller's ... Many customers faint ... teller pops in ... seems to walk through ... walls ..."
